content.short: Blueberry is a Hyperliquid DeFi terminal that tokenizes HLP vault yield into composable assets.
content.description: Blueberry is a DeFi terminal for HyperEVM whose Hypervault takes deposits and earns yield sourced from Hyperliquid's HLP vault. Depositors receive bbHLP, a token representing the position, which other protocols can accept as collateral or trade. The minimum deposit is ten dollars, and deposits currently earn a boosted Berries multiplier. The interface also covers bridging and ecosystem integrations, with the BLB governance token deployed on Ethereum mainnet.
content.meta: Turns Hyperliquid HLP vault yield into a token other protocols can price and accept as collateral.
